role_assignments_scope.name: role_assignments_scope
role_assignments_scope.value: CASE WHEN "role_assignments"."role" IN ('coach', 'team_manager') THEN num_nonnulls("role_assignments"."team_id", "role_assignments"."class_id") = 1 ELSE num_nonnulls("role_assignments"."team_id", "role_assignments"."class_id") = 0 END

bookings_attendance_non_negative.name: bookings_attendance_non_negative
bookings_attendance_non_negative.value:
("bookings"."expected_attendance" IS NULL OR "bookings"."expected_attendance" >= 0)
        AND ("bookings"."actual_attendance" IS NULL OR "bookings"."actual_attendance" >= 0)

documents_dates.name: documents_dates
documents_dates.value: "documents"."issued_on" IS NULL OR "documents"."expires_on" IS NULL OR "documents"."expires_on" >= "documents"."issued_on"

staff_assignments_dates.name: staff_assignments_dates
staff_assignments_dates.value: "staff_assignments"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "staff_assignments"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "staff_assignments"."ends_on" >= "staff_assignments"."starts_on"
